metadata.title: Backup and Recovery

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for restoring data and systems following loss, corruption, or disruption.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Backup, recovery, and data protection technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Systematic, policy-driven data backup and restoration pattern.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Backup and recovery mitigates impact of ATT&CK destruction, impact, and sabotage techniques.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Backup and recovery aligns with D3FEND recovery and restore defensive techniques.

metadata.remarks: Backup and Recovery defines the capability to create, protect, and restore backups of data and systems. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to support auditability and resilience against data loss, corruption, or malicious destruction.

components.title: Backup Creation and Scheduling
components.description: Regular, automated creation of backups in accordance with defined policies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Backups of user-level, system-level, and application data are created and maintained according to established schedules.

components.title: Backup Protection and Immutability
components.description: Protection of backups from unauthorized modification, deletion, or ransomware impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Backups are protected against unauthorized access, alteration, and destruction.
Backup mechanisms support resilience and recovery through protected and isolated storage.

components.title: Recovery and Restore Procedures
components.description: Documented and tested procedures to restore data and systems from backups.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery procedures are defined, exercised, and used to restore systems following disruption.
Backup and recovery processes are tested to verify effectiveness.
